duration.q: How long does it take to build a website?
duration.a: Landing Pages take about 5–7 working days. Business or Online Store sites run 2–3 weeks, depending on content complexity.

tech.q: Do I need to understand technology?
tech.a: No. The Webmula team handles setup, design, development and contact integration until the site is ready to use.

revision.a: Yes. Design revisions happen at the layout draft stage before the site goes live.

whatsapp.a: Yes. The chat button links directly to your business WhatsApp number with an auto opening message.
